data.name: Ferroptosis
data.description: Iron-dependent, lipid-peroxidation-driven regulated cell death that is modulated by mTOR signalling and autophagy.
data.description_beginner: A distinct way for a cell to die: iron inside the cell sets off a chain reaction that shreds the fatty membranes holding it together. It is not the tidy, programmed suicide most cells use, and both mTOR signalling and autophagy change how easily it happens.
